svg.aria-label: A version bump in Git becomes a gated node roll: 1. Pin: A version bump in the TalosUpgrade or KubernetesUpgrade CR is the upgrade. Renovate opens it as a pull request. 2. Gate: Before a node is touched, tuppr checks that no kopiur mover is running and that Ceph reports HEALTH_OK. 3. Reboot: The node is hard-reset with powercycle, then boots the new Talos image. 4. Wait: A failing check is retried, not skipped. A stuck mover holds the roll until it finishes. 5. Continue: When the node is back and healthy, tuppr moves to the next one and the gates run again.
